Hi Alex / Samantha,

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through Finlytics' current workflow for document classification and the latency/cost constraints you mentioned. Quick recap from our side:  

- Goals: reduce inference cost for batch scoring, improve 95th pct latency on short-text inference, add better observability for route-level token spend.
- Current blockers: bursty workloads with unpredictable peaks, no KV caching today, limited telemetry on token-level cost.
- Signals that would make this a success: 30% per-token cost reduction, sub-150ms p95 for small payloads, audit logs for compliance.

We think the next best step is a short technical deep-dive + demo where Dev (cc'd) can validate integration assumptions (API, prefix caching, and VM-side deployment options). Proposed slots next week (PT):

- Wed Jul 8: 10:00-10:45 AM
- Wed Jul 8: 2:00-2:45 PM
- Thu Jul 9: 1:00-1:45 PM

If none of those work, feel free to reply with 2-3 times that do. I attached a one-page summary of our discovery notes for your records.

Thanks, looking forward to aligning calendars. If you prefer I can send a calendar invite once you confirm a slot.
